evidence.quote: order dated 29.04.2024 passed under Section 73 of the U.P. Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
no date was fixed for personal hearing

events.details: appeal dismissed as filed beyond limitation
events.quote: the order dated 01.04.2025 whereby the appeal was dismissed as being beyond limitation

defects_argued.quote: the impugned orders cannot be sustained and the orders dated 29.04.2024 & 01.04.2025 are accordingly quashed
the order is also violative of Section 75(7) of the Act of 2017

outcome.quote: Matter is remanded to the assessing authority to pass fresh order after giving an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner

annotation.notes: Almost no notice facts are stated: no notice date, tax period or amount. The State's own counsel admits no hearing date was fixed (para 4). The finding (para 6) applies a precedent (Mahaveer Trading, quoted in para 5) to this case. The s.75(7) argument (para 3) is never ruled on, so not_decided; the quote is the argument, not a finding. Schema gap: the appellate order (appeal dismissed as time-barred) was quashed too; no field for it. Paras 6-8 are the court's own but the splitter merges them into para 5 (they start mid-line after the quoted precedent).
